en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha who said, 
‘I asked Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>
about the Words of Allahazwj the Exalted [16:16] And Signs; and by the star they are being guided.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘We<sup>asws</sup> are the ‘signs’, and the ‘star’ is Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from MuAlia ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ who has said that he asked Imam al-Rida (a.s.) about the meaning of the words of Allah, the Most High, “Through the signs and with the star people do find their way.” [16:16]
The Imams (a.s.) said, “We are the signs and the messenger of Allah is the star,”
